resolution.title: Add test case to prevent show BGP command failures from containers with ‘bgp’ in name
resolution.description:
### Description of PR

Summary:
Fixes https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/issues/19475
`show ip bgp ...` commands should not assume that there's only one container that contains the name bgp
Add a new testcase to prevent regression.

Test failed with error message:

```
FAILED bgp/test_bgp_command.py::test_bgp_commands_with_like_bgp_container[sonic-ipv6] - Failed: BGP command failed with 'No such command' error when like-bgp container is present. Error: Usage: show ipv6 [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

Test an newer image with this fix, and test passed.
